group_assessment.counts_measured: PubMed esearch 2026-10-03 (tool=LEGEND-research): 'Burkly L[au]' 179, 'Burkly L[au] AND WWOX' 0.
group_assessment.weighting: A pharmaceutical sponsor with deep immunology capability, which is exactly the capability this result requires and exactly the capability the contradicting source lacks. The OBSERVATION carries weight: the day-5 time course, the DRG transcriptomics, the immune-cell ISH and IHC and the three-cargo replication are measurements no other source in this group made. The INTERPRETATION carries less: 'causal role for the immune response' rests on a multi-target pharmacological block with three animals per group, no antigen-specific T cells were detected, and the effector mechanism is labelled a postulate by the authors themselves.
group_assessment.note: None of the six sources in this group mentions WWOX (grep -icE 'wwox|wox1|16q23' over each artefact returns 0, run 2026-10-03). They are platform, dose and toxicology sources read for transferable method, so the group question is not 'is this laboratory authoritative on WWOX' but 'who paid for this measurement and does a second party corroborate it'. Four independent origins are represented: an academic viral-vector core (Gunma University), a sponsor with its own clinical candidate (Exegenesis Bio), an academic gene-therapy laboratory on foundation money (UT Southwestern), and two pharmaceutical sponsors (Biogen; Novartis). PMID 35331006 and PMID 36700120 are BOTH Novartis, share four authors (Tukov, Meseck, Penraat, Chand) and the latter pools data from the Novartis study warehouse, with three study descriptors matching the former's studies (Mauritius-origin non-GLP cohort; two studies using Omnipaque 180 contrast; an intravenous arm at about 1.0e14 vg/kg). They are therefore NOT independent sources and are not counted as mutual corroboration. Research-group knowledge base is excluded from the public edition; this rests on the papers' own author lists, affiliations and declarations of interest.

field_density.note: Zero WWOX density in the source itself, and near-zero in the literature that would connect WWOX to this group's subject matter: against 710 WWOX records, only 2 also mention adeno-associated vectors or AAV, 2 mention dorsal root ganglion and 1 mentions neurofilament, while the AAV DRG-toxicity literature itself holds 35 records. This is an earned null on the gene axis and the expected result: the group was assigned as transferable-method sources, not as WWOX sources. Every statement carried out of this reading is a lesson from another gene or species with its transfer limit stated, never a WWOX datum. The numbers also establish why transfer is unavoidable here: there is no WWOX AAV safety literature to read instead.

corpus_crossquery.query: Which existing research-layer records already carry a dorsal-root-ganglion toxicity statement or an AAV CNS dose statement that this group would corroborate, sharpen or contradict? Measured with: git grep -l -i 'dorsal root ganglio' -- disease-models/wwox/research/
corpus_crossquery.note: Compared, AFTER the first pass was written, against the wave-3 candidate CC-20261003W3-C-RESTORATION-SPEC-01 (the six-parameter restoration specification). Three contacts: (1) that candidate records PMID 40349107 using serum NfL as a toxicity biomarker with a threshold of 1,719 pg/mL or greater, and PMID 36700120 supplies the operating characteristics that threshold lacks (n=260, ROC AUC, sensitivity/specificity at five fold-change cut-offs); (2) that candidate states no therapeutic window has been measured for any DEE gene in its set, and PMID 41992613 is the closest thing in this corpus to a two-sided window result yet still does not measure one, which corroborates and sharpens the wave-3 negative rather than overturning it; (3) that candidate carries DRG toxicity as an AAV class effect, and PMIDs 41404412 / 35331006 / 36700120 are the literature in which the mechanism of that class effect is contested.

entries.proposition: PANEL READING. Figure 5 is representative imagery without quantification, and on it the day-5 claim is carried by two of the four named cell types, not four. The quantification that would settle it is in a supplementary figure this reading did not fetch, so the panel neither confirms nor contradicts the sentence.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 5, day 5 row: the CD20 image shows a discrete brown focus and the CD4 image scattered brown signal, both above the vehicle row; the NCR1 (NKp46) and CD303 (CLEC4C) in-situ images and the CD68 image at day 5 are not visibly distinguishable from the vehicle row at this magnification. The CD8 column is essentially unstained in every row shown, vehicle through day 29. The dense infiltrates are in the day 15 and day 29 rows.
